verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs workloads from standard Docker images and offers standard PostgreSQL plus a REST API over Apps, Machines and Volumes, so app code and databases sit in open, portable formats. However, nothing in the pack documents a data-export or offboarding path. Community reports cut against easy exit: one user could not find a way to SFTP into a disk, and another said an account-deletion request went unanswered. Missing for 10: documented export tooling for volumes, Postgres and config; explicit open-format export guarantees; a clean account offboarding and deletion process; independent confirmation that data can be fully extracted.
